items.exampleEn: Only a select group of customers can join the event.
items.exampleZh: 只有一小群精選的顧客可以參加這個活動。

items.exampleEn: A typical day for me starts at seven.
items.exampleZh: 我平常的一天從七點開始。

items.exampleEn: It is rare to see snow in Taipei.
Water is essential for all living things.
items.exampleZh: 水對所有生物都是必需的。

items.exampleEn: My office is on the upper floor.
This is definitely the best soup I have ever had.
items.exampleZh: 這絕對是我喝過最好喝的湯。

items.exampleEn: The street is too narrow for big trucks.
items.exampleZh: 這條街太窄了，大卡車開不進去。

items.exampleEn: This old bridge is still very solid.
items.exampleZh: 這座老橋仍然非常堅固。

items.sentenceEn: A good pair of shoes is essential for a long walk.
items.sentenceZh: 走遠路時，一雙好鞋是不可少的。

items.audioEn: This shop is definitely closed today, so let's come back tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 這家店今天肯定沒開，我們明天再來吧。

items.sentenceEn: This rare book is worth more than my car.
items.sentenceZh: 這本罕見的書比我的車還值錢。

items.sentenceEn: The upper part of the wall needs new paint.
items.sentenceZh: 牆壁上半部需要重新上漆。

items.stemEn: The path is so ____ that only one person can walk on it at a time.
items.stemZh: 這條小路很窄，一次只能走一個人。

items.stemEn: Don't worry. I will ____ call you when I arrive.
items.stemZh: 別擔心，我到了一定會打電話給你。

items.passageEn: What is my typical weekend like? I definitely sleep late on Saturday morning. Then I take a narrow path up the hill behind my home. At the top, there is a solid old bench where I sit and read. Sometimes I see rare birds in the upper branches of the trees. For me, this quiet time is essential. I share this place with only a select few friends, the ones who love nature.
items.passageZh: 我平常的週末是什麼樣子？星期六早上我一定會睡晚一點。然後我會走一條窄窄的小路，爬上我家後面的山丘。山頂有一張堅固的老長椅，我會坐在那裡看書。有時候我會在樹的高處枝頭看到罕見的鳥。對我來說，這段安靜的時間是不可缺少的。我只和少數幾位精挑細選的朋友分享這個地方，就是那些熱愛大自然的朋友。

questions.questionZh: 作者會和誰分享這個地方？

referenceEn: This kind of bird is rare in Taiwan.
This bird is very rare in Taiwan.
rubricZh: rare 表示「罕見的」，可放在 be 動詞後
「這種鳥」可寫 this kind of bird、this bird 等
寫 It is rare to see this bird in Taiwan. 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 essential 造一個句子，說說一樣對你來說不可缺少的東西。
referenceEn: Coffee is essential for me in the morning.
My phone is essential for my work.
rubricZh: essential 表示「必要的、不可缺少的」，常用 be essential for／to（例如 essential for me）
說的是自己生活中的東西（例如 me、my）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
